---
title: "5 Terracidiphilus Analysis"
output: html_document
---

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Libraries
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)

metabolic_result_terracidiphilus_path <- "data/METABOLIC_result_terracidiphilus_5_Carter.xlsx"
df_5 <- read_excel(metabolic_result_terracidiphilus_path)
# glimpse(df_5)
```


```{r}
df_5 %>%
  select(Category) %>%
  unique()
# glimpse()
```

Terracidiphilus has functions in 25 different categories, shown here.


```{r}
df_5 %>% 
  filter(terracidiphilus.Hmm.presence == "Present") %>%
  filter(ocallatibacter_riparius.Hmm.presence == "Absent") %>%
  filter(telmotobacter_bradus.Hmm.presence == "Absent") %>%
  select(Function)
```

Terracidiphilus has Acetate => Acetaldehyde and Ni-Fe Hydrogenase functionalities which ocallatibacter riparius and telmotobacter bradus don't have.
